description: This is a Java test source file for the PoliciesConditionalHeadersValidator class, testing its behavior with various conditional headers related to policy resources in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PoliciesConditionalHeadersValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for PoliciesConditionalHeadersValidator, testing strictness and exception handling for conditional headers.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the PoliciesConditionalHeadersValidatorProvider class is immutable.

methods.name: doesNotThrowExceptionsIfAllChecksSucceed
methods.description: Tests that the validator does not throw exceptions when headers match expected conditions.

methods.name: doesNotThrowExceptionsIfCheckIsSkippedBecauseOfNullAndQuery
methods.description: Ensures that checks are skipped for command category QUERY when headers are null.

methods.name: doesNotThrowExceptionsIfCheckIsSkippedBecauseOfNullAndDelete
methods.description: Ensures that checks are skipped for command category DELETE when headers are null.

methods.name: doesNotSkipIfEntityTagIsNullAndCategoryIsModify
methods.description: Verifies that the check proceeds when entity tag is null and category is MODIFY.

methods.name: throwsPolicyPreconditionFailedExceptionWhenIfMatchFails
methods.description: Checks that a PolicyPreconditionFailedException is thrown when if-match validation fails.

methods.name: throwsPolicyPreconditionFailedExceptionWhenIfNoneMatchFailsAndCategoryIsNotQuery
methods.description: Verifies that a failed if-none-match header validation throws the correct exception for categories other than QUERY.

methods.name: throwsPolicyPreconditionNotModifiedExceptionWhenIfNoneMatchFailsAndCategoryIsQuery
methods.description: Verifies that a not-modified exception is thrown when if-none-match fails during a QUERY command and the category is QUERY.

methods.name: createCommandMock
methods.description: Helper method to create a mock Command object with specified headers and category.

methods.name: assertSkipForCommandCategory
methods.description: Helper method to verify that checks are skipped for specific command categories.

methods.name: assertETagHeaderInDre
methods.description: Asserts that the exception's headers contain the expected entity tag.

methods.name: assertPreconditionFailed
methods.description: Helper for asserting that a PolicyPreconditionFailedException is thrown with the correct message.

methods.name: assertNotModified
methods.description: Helper for asserting that a PolicyPreconditionNotModifiedException is thrown with the correct message.
